text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate observed from canary cluster prod-us-west-canary (service=model-api). 12% error rate over 5m, spike started ~1769804100. Auto-remediation not triggered.

maria (oncall): ack — I'm on call. Paging primary.

ops-rotation-bot: paging ajay (primary oncall) — incident assigned.

ajay: I'm on it. pulling logs + checking k8s state. can everyone drop any recent deploy links?

chris: rolled canary for model-api ~1769804000, overlay changes included an autoscale template tweak. I'm looking at the manifests now.

ajay: getting pod list — several pods in CrashLoopBackOff and a bunch scaled to 0. suspicious that HPA/minReplicas is 0 for the canary.

ajay: kubectl snapshot:

```

$ kubectl get hpa -n prod | grep model-api
model-api-hpa   0%/100%   0            0           10m
```

ajay: yep — minReplicas=0. that would allow entire canary pool to scale to zero under missing metrics.

chris: confirmed — templating variable for min_replicas defaulted to 0 in the canary overlay (`{{min_replicas}} || 0`). that slipped through because overlay diff didn't catch defaults.

maria (oncall): Impact? how much user traffic hit the canary vs stable?

eng-release: Routing: 15% of traffic was directed to canary. that 15% saw elevated 5xx as the canary scaled to 0 -> 502/503 from ingress.

ajay: mitigation plan: (1) flip traffic kill-switch away from canary (2) roll back canary manifest to previous stable revision (3) patch manifest in repo and run gated deploy.

maria (oncall): execute kill-switch now. chris, can you flip traffic-router flag? I don't want to wait for rollout.

chris: doing it now — calling traffic-router API.

```

# flip canary off
curl -X POST https://traffic-router.internal/api/v1/switch -d '{"service":"model-api","traffic":0,"target":"stable"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'

# response:
{"ok":true, "changed": {"canary":0}}
```

chris: done — traffic routed back to stable. ingresses show 100% to stable. monitoring shows error-rate trending down. :white_check_mark:

eng-release: starting rollback of deployment/model-api-canary -> previous revision r43. kickoff at 1769804300.

incident-bot: DEPLOYMENT EVENT: rollback started for model-api-canary by eng-release.

ajay: rollout status:

```

$ kubectl rollout status deploy/model-api -n prod
deployment "model-api" successfully rolled out
```

ajay: new stable pods healthy, error-rate back to baseline within ~3m of kill-switch. current incident impact window ~4 minutes of elevated errors affecting 15% of traffic.

sre_jen: noted. root cause candidate: templating default of min_replicas=0 in canary overlay + lack of CI lint/gate for min_replicas. Also lack of synthetic traffic check for canary readiness.

maria (oncall): any customer-facing impact? any large customers hit?

eng-release: early logs: a handful of requests from medium-tier customers retried; no P0 support tickets yet. recommend monitoring support queue for 2h.

chris: immediate action items:
- repo: add schema/lint to prevent min_replicas < 1 in overlays (owner: chris)
- infra: add canary traffic guard that will pause routing if replicas == 0 (owner: ajay)
- release: add post-deploy smoke test verifying endpoints before routing traffic (owner: eng-release)

sre_jen: also propose adding an alert: HPA configured with minReplicas < 1 in prod clusters -> critical. I can PR in 30m.

maria (oncall): assigning tasks, leaving a short handover to next oncall (ajay remains, but second oncall off in 30m). summary for oncall handoff:
- incident 1769804123: canary scaled to 0 due to min_replicas templating bug, ~15% of traffic got 5xx for ~4m. rollback + traffic-kill executed. actions assigned.

ajay: will monitor for 60m, I'll follow up on infra guard.

chris: pushing patch to repo now with fix + tests.

incident-bot: incident severity set to Sev3. incident timeline noted, creating incident ticket: INC-2026-0421.

maria (oncall): thanks all — file a short postmortem (blameless) with timeline + next steps. i'll close the incident thread after 2h if no regressions.

eng-release: noted. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/model-api/pulls/298 (patch + lint).

sre_jen: I'll add the HPA lint rule and a canary-smoke check in staging.

maria (oncall): handing off to night oncall in 2h — keep paging if anything regresses. thread will be used for postmortem notes.

chris: quick nudge — add a CI test asserting min_replicas >=1 for all overlays. that would have prevented this.

ajay: observed metrics: error-rate back to baseline, request latency unaffected, no further 5xx spikes. closing monitoring loop.

maria (oncall): closing immediate incident actions. we'll draft the postmortem. good catch and quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
